title: RelPrism: Multi-Faceted Self-Supervised Learning on Relational Databases
abstract: arXiv:2605.23241v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Relational databases (RDBs) remain the backbone of modern data systems and support a broad spectrum of predictive tasks that require multi-faceted information from different perspectives and granularities. For example, user churn prediction is often formulated as a binary classification task that relies more on user interaction patterns reflecting activity levels, whereas consumption value estimation is a fine-grained regression task that may require composite evidence from both user attributes and user--item interaction behaviors. Therefore, a central challenge is to learn representations with comprehensive coverage of the information underlying RDB tasks. A natural solution is to leverage self-supervised learning (SSL) for pre-training. translated_title: RelPrism：面向关系型数据库的多方面自监督学习
translated_abstract: 关系型数据库（RDBs）仍然是现代数据系统的骨干，支持着广泛需要从不同视角和粒度获取多方面信息的预测任务。例如，用户流失预测通常被表述为一个二元分类任务，更依赖于反映活跃程度的用户交互模式；而消费价值估计则是一个细粒度的回归任务，可能需要来自用户属性和用户-物品交互行为的综合证据。因此，一个核心挑战是学习能够全面覆盖RDB任务底层信息的表示。一个自然的解决方案是利用自监督学习（SSL）进行预训练。然而，现有的SSL方法通常从单一方面（如节点级内在属性或子图级关系结构）获取监督信号，因此其预训练目标……
tldr: 提出RelPrism框架，通过从节点属性、关系结构等多个方面进行自监督预训练，学习能够全面覆盖关系型数据库上多样化预测任务所需信息的表示，克服了现有SSL方法仅依赖单一监督方面的局限。
en_tdlr: RelPrism proposes a multi-faceted self-supervised pre-training framework on relational databases that learns representations comprehensively covering the information required by diverse predictive tasks, overcoming the limitation of existing SSL methods that rely on a single supervision facet.
